evidence: The orchestrator entry point names the live Snowflake target and security harness.
The DAG defines dependencies, exclusive file ownership, a single Snowflake mutator, stage gates, reduced-demo behavior, and task-report requirements.
Every implementation task has instructions, success criteria, and an optional skills field.
The continuous control loop and append-only reviewed-decision protocol are encoded in AGENTS.md and ORCHESTRATOR_PROMPT.md.
